question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled PR land after the contributor supplies inspectable after-fix QA-bus proof, or should a QA-channel owner provide equivalent verification?
rationale: The patch has a narrow stated boundary and focused test evidence, but the required external-PR real-behavior proof is not visible in the supplied body or discussion.

options.title: Add live QA-bus proof
options.body: Post a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or recording showing a streamed block followed by an identical final reaches the consumer only once.

options.title: Owner verifies live behavior
options.body: A QA-channel owner can independently reproduce the scenario and attach equivalent redacted after-fix evidence before landing.

recommendation.title: Add live QA-bus proof
recommendation.body: Post a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or recording showing a streamed block followed by an identical final reaches the consumer only once.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the original live reproduction claim and are best placed to provide the corresponding after-fix evidence.
